scope: train/dev only; no heldout, test, Laya, JEV, or API evaluation
comparison: new typed head on a frozen BF16 backbone versus the same initialized typed head plus rank-2 final-layer q/v LoRA

data.split: same deterministic grouped split bound in ../SELECTION-FREEZE.json
data.text: same model-specific profile-compiled generic text-v2 inputs; cached embedding arrays stripped and never consumed by either neural arm

matched_controls.train_question_order: same seed and deterministic epoch shuffle in both arms
matched_controls.optimizer: AdamW with identical learning rate, weight decay, clipping, schedule, and microbatch=1
matched_controls.head: 4096 -> 192 GELU -> independent scalar choice/noul/score heads; FP32; seed=314159
matched_controls.lora: only treatment difference: final decoder block q_proj/v_proj; rank=2, alpha=4; BF16 base and FP32 adapters
matched_controls.selection: maximize equal-weight mean of choice/noul/score exact accuracy over the fixed 200-question dev set; tie-break lower mean objective loss, lower score normalized expected-value MAE, then earlier epoch
matched_controls.initial_parity: same initial head tensor SHA-256 and initial logits within 1e-6 on the same train-only example

resource_guards.swap: abort if system swap exceeds the process-start baseline or 4 GiB

interrupted_partial_attempts.reason: Stopped before any epoch completed to correct global L2 gradient-clipping geometry; preserved but excluded. All full arms restart into fresh directories.

corrected_smoke_suite: smoke-corrected/{qwen,harrier}-{head,lora}/; all four one-update smokes passed after global L2 clipping was corrected
